title: The Coffee Shop Counter
stimulusText: You glance at a café counter for a few seconds before ordering. On the counter: a green ceramic mug with a chipped handle, a stack of five brown paper napkins, a tip jar with a handwritten sign reading 'Thanks!', and a small chalkboard listing three drinks: Latte, Cold Brew, Chai.
stimulusFacts: mug is green ceramic with a chipped handle
five brown paper napkins
tip jar sign reads 'Thanks!'
chalkboard lists three drinks: Latte, Cold Brew, Chai

questions.prompt: What color was the mug?
How many napkins were in the stack?
The chalkboard listed four drinks.
What word was written on the tip jar sign?

title: Odd One Out: Shapes

it is the fourth item in the row

title: Yesterday's Commute
stimulusText: Picture this commute: a bus arrives 4 minutes late, the driver is wearing a red cap, an advertisement poster inside the bus is for a dentist, and a man reads a newspaper folded into quarters near the back door.
stimulusFacts: bus arrived 4 minutes late
driver wore a red cap
poster advertised a dentist

title: Waiting Room
stimulusText: A waiting room holds six chairs, four of them occupied. A television plays with the sound off, showing a weather map. A potted plant sits by the door missing several leaves on one side. A clipboard with a sign-in sheet has seven names listed.
stimulusFacts: six chairs, four occupied
television was muted, showing a weather map
potted plant missing leaves on one side
sign-in sheet had seven names listed

questions.prompt: How many chairs were occupied?
The television had the sound on.
How many names were on the sign-in sheet?

title: Two Photographs Compared
stimulusText: Imagine two nearly identical photos of a living room taken seconds apart. In the first, a book lies open on the coffee table and the window is closed. In the second, the book is closed and the window is open a crack. Everything else — the lamp, the rug, the couch cushions — is unchanged.
stimulusFacts: the book went from open to closed
the window went from closed to open a crack
the lamp, rug, and couch cushions stayed unchanged

questions.prompt: What changed about the book between photos?
The window went from closed to open a crack.
Name one object that stayed the same in both photos.
